title: The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order (part 4/8: sections 06 and 09)
main_claim: Section 06 (Lemma lem:small-polynomial-broad-side): if a balanced tagged mixture has first laws of width at most n^gamma, second laws with N max nu_i <= n^{D_*}, and degree at least 1-n^{-p_0} on supports, then some color contains Q_n. Section 09 (Prop. prop:intermediate-bias-exclusion): in the stabilized counterexample, neither H^dagger<1 nor (H^dagger>=1 and 0<H_L^dagger<1) can occur.
coverage:
Section 06, Lemma lem:small-polynomial-broad-side: VERIFIED line by line at the level of checkable steps.
- Preliminary dichotomy: Pi' truncation (discarded mass <= n^{-D_*}, Pi' <= O(K)/N); case 1 applied to Lemma lem:constant-broad-high-neighborhood with tag y~Pi' restricted. I checked width(B_y) <= n^gamma, the pointwise mean E B_y <= O(K)/N, Omega(N) partner columns, and opposite-color degree > .99 >= .95. Case 2: union bound giving mass > .8 for the relation.
- Base tags: restriction mass >= c_0-c_1, and eta_y <= n^{2D_*} Lambda.
- Step 1 (predictive-density deletion bound) and Step 2 (T_beta <= n^{d_2 u}Lambda and <= n^{d_2 u}T_{beta,-l}). Exponent bookkeeping d_0 + d_1|S| + delta_2 u <= d_2 u uses |S| <= C(j+1). Degree support claims and common-hit mass c_1 - O(m eps) >= c_1/2.
- Step 3, low targets: per-label factors (1+4eps/c_1) and 2/c_1; .16k deletion bound; cap O(J^2 log n) = o(m^{.15}). High targets: four-term width budget, kappa(log(2/c_1)+.02) < .002, total < .05 J log n.
- Exponent halving .018 -> .009 -> .0045 -> .00225 >= c_2 = .001. Step 2/3 union costs vanish for small alpha. log D_n < c_2 k/2. Disjoint-failure bound D_n^n e^{-c_2 kn}.
- Selected-posterior adjustment: the fallback bound e^{-.02k} * #descriptors * pi, with descriptor count < e^{.01k}. Odd loads: boundary n^{-.05+d_1}, high n^{-.13J} n^{.05J}, sign repeats n 2^{-m+o(m)} e^{m^{.15}}. Additional even mean: the cancellation over (I_h, Z_S) re-derived; it gives T_0, and E_Pi eta = Lambda.
- Near-product injection hypotheses (atoms N^{-1+o(1)}, column <= .4, n^2 <= N^{.025}). F_z <= e^{.34kn}Q (.2k + .1k per matching neighbor, o(kn) for the o(n^{.4}) others). Gated-posterior use. Joint density e^{.4kn} (needs gamma<1). Heavy-set bound with .8*.55 > .4. Close-repeat condition H_bin(2 rho) < log 2 - .55 is feasible. Hall: |A|/N, |B|/N -> 0.
Not re-verified (outside my block, taken as cited): internals of Lemma 5's height/center mechanism, and Lemmas conditional-avoidance, scattered-moments, height-selection, near-product-injection, gated-posterior and balanced-profiles.

Section 09, Definition def:limiting-bias-exponents and Prop. prop:intermediate-bias-exclusion: VERIFIED.
- Parameter selection, both cases: monotonicity/pigeonhole along the diagonal. Sublinear compatibility 1-y_d < sigma < x_s/10, with chi < (1-y)/10 < sigma/10. Linear-case ordering of alpha_d, alpha_s using f(x) = lim_alpha H_L. Use of H^dagger >= 1 to get h_broad > h_+.
- Shallow restriction cost O(log n).
- Crowd-table means: V_{r-1}/V ~ r/n, V_{r+1}/V ~ n/r, with thresholds b_0 < eps and b_0 + sigma < chi/2 (linear) or y_m + sigma < 1 (sublinear). Overlap check.
- Read-multiplicity identity d(c,v'^{ij}) = d + 2 - 2(1_i + 1_j), giving the r+3 bound, including the level-window argument (heights within 1 at distance <= 2). Core size.
- Width budget S_s + O(n^u) + log(1/.49)(T+m) < S_d in both cases. Repeated-word tag cost (m log 2 > S_s).
- Linear tag condition: Hoeffding exponent n a_*^2/b_*^2 >> n^u.
- Mask minimax and Markov mass (1/2)e^{-n^u}.
- Conditional mean via weighted mean with O(k b_*^2) loss; erasure identity and the psi/tau rescaling. Covariance tail: t = n^{8chi}, E||S||^2 = O(t) since t b_*^2 = o(1), mass c rho^{t+1}, u + 8chi < x_s, ratio n^{2chi-(h_+-h_-)} -> infinity. Core shift O(k a_* n^{-2chi}) = o(a_*), and k b_*^2 = o(a_*) using chi + h_+ < 2h_-.
- Surplus: (n-m)a_* - .06 n a_*; sublinear m b_* = o(n a_*). Finner concentration exponent n^{1-sigma-2(h_+-h_-)} >> n^u. Quadratic loss n b_*^2 = o(n a_*), since h_+ < 2h_-.
- Predictive failure via gated posterior with F_x <= 2^n e^{-c_4 n a_*} P^-. Avoidance charges e^{-cn^u} versus dependency e^{O(n^sigma log n)}, using sigma < u.
- Odd loads: S_d < n log 2 - O(r log n). Even cap 2^n e^{-c_4 n a_*/2}, using n^{x_s} = o(n a_*). Repeat cost and Hall.
Not re-verified (cited): the adapted scale induction of Lemma height-selection, and Lemmas clock-sampling, balanced-profiles and Cor. asymmetric-discrepancy.
sibling_notes: Both sections lean heavily on lem:height-selection, lem:conditional-avoidance, lem:scattered-moments, lem:gated-posterior and lem:near-product-injection/clock-sampling (section 03), and section 06 also leans on the center/height mechanism of Lemma 5 (section 05). The reviewers of 03 and 05 should confirm three things. (1) Height-selection still works with the step-2 cross-slice paths and only the three crowd tests used in 09, without the radius-(r+2) test. (2) The positive-height selection bound in 06 is position-averaged, as 06 states. (3) In 09 the scale-induction constraints are 0 < sigma_h < zeta and b_0 > a > zeta + sigma_h + (1-theta), with chi/2 > a + 4 sigma_h.
